newsitem.title: UK: Ghana cocoa purchases reach 291,788 T by Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: Ghana cocoa purchases reach 291,788 T by Feb 20.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases in the 19th week of the 1996/97 season ending February 20 were 5,072 tonnes with the cumulative reaching 291,788 tonnes, the Ghana Cocoa Board said on Monday.
Weekly purchases had amounted to 5,158 tonnes in the 18th week of the season.

The latest data compared with 5,204 tonnes in the week ending Feb 22 last season when the cumulative was 329,509 tonnes. By the 19th week, which corresponded to Feb 15 purchases, purchases had totalled 324,305 tonnes.
